zh.title: 受颱風白海豚影響星宇航空8月8日往返沖繩航班全數取消
zh.summary: 受颱風白海豚持續影響沖繩地區，星宇航空於2026年8月8日宣布，當天台灣往返沖繩的所有航班全數取消，包含原訂安排的加班機JX1870與JX1871。根據中央氣象署8日上午8時觀測，颱風白海豚中心位於台北東北東方約510公里處，航空公司提醒旅客搭機前關注最新航班資訊。
body: 受颱風白海豚持續影響沖繩地區，星宇航空於2026年8月8日宣布，當天台灣往返沖繩的所有航班全數取消，其中包括原訂安排的加班機JX1870與JX1871。星宇航空先前曾規劃於8月8日及9日增開加班機以疏運旅客，但因天候影響決定調整航班作業。
根據中央氣象署於8日上午8時的觀測數據，颱風白海豚的中心位置位於台北東北東方約510公里處。星宇航空呼籲搭機旅客於出發前密切留意最新航班動態，並可透過星宇航空官方網站或客服中心查詢詳細資訊。

en.title: STARLUX Cancels All Okinawa Flights Aug 8 Due to Typhoon Dolphin
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines announced on August 8, 2026, that all flights between Taiwan and Okinawa scheduled for the day have been canceled due to the ongoing impact of Typhoon Dolphin. The cancellations include extra flights JX1870 and JX1871, which were previously scheduled to help transport affected passengers. According to Taiwan's Central Weather Administration, Typhoon Dolphin was positioned approximately 510 kilometers east-northeast of Taipei as of 8:00 a.m. on August 8. The airline has urged passengers to check the official website for updated flight information prior to departure.
body: STARLUX Airlines announced on August 8, 2026, that all flights operating between Taiwan and Okinawa for the day have been canceled due to the ongoing impact of Typhoon Dolphin. The canceled operations include extra flights JX1870 and JX1871, which had been scheduled previously to assist in moving passengers affected by the severe weather conditions.

Data from Taiwan's Central Weather Administration showed that as of 8:00 a.m. on August 8, Typhoon Dolphin was centered approximately 510 kilometers east-northeast of Taipei. STARLUX Airlines advised passengers traveling on affected routes to monitor updated flight status on its official website or contact customer service prior to departure.
